# Toolset `employer_resumes`

Resume search (52 params), saved searches, comments.

**11 tools.** Mutations require an explicit `confirm=true` argument; `Auth` marks tools that need an hh.ru token.

| Tool | Operation | Auth | Confirm | Description |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | --- |
| `employer_add_applicant_comment` | `POST /applicant_comments/{applicant_id}` | yes | yes | Add a comment on an applicant (paid access). body (form-encoded): {"text": str, "access_type": str}; access_type ids are listed in applicant_comment_access_type (get_dictionaries). Returns 201. |
| `employer_assign_saved_search_manager` | `PUT /saved_searches/resumes/{saved_search_id}/managers/{manager_id}` | yes | yes | Transfer a saved resume search to another manager of the company (manager ids from employer_list_managers). Returns 204 on success. |
| `employer_create_saved_search` | `POST /saved_searches/resumes` | yes | yes | Create a saved resume search (auto-search). All filters are query parameters, the same set as employer_search_resumes minus the text.logic/text.field/text.period triad (not representable here; a created search uses the default text matching mode). Returns 201 with the Location header pointing to the new search. |
| `employer_delete_applicant_comment` | `DELETE /applicant_comments/{applicant_id}/{comment_id}` | yes | yes | Delete own comment on an applicant (paid access, author only). Returns 204 on success. |
| `employer_delete_saved_search` | `DELETE /saved_searches/resumes/{id}` | yes | yes | Delete a saved resume search by id. Returns 204 on success. |
| `employer_get_saved_search` | `GET /saved_searches/resumes/{id}` | yes | – | Get one saved resume search by id, including its query, new_items counter (refreshed hourly) and last_used. |
| `employer_list_applicant_comments` | `GET /applicant_comments/{applicant_id}` | yes | – | List comments on an applicant: own comments plus comments of colleagues shared with the company (paid access). order_by ids come from applicant_comments_order (get_dictionaries). |
| `employer_list_saved_searches` | `GET /saved_searches/resumes` | yes | – | List saved resume searches (auto-searches) of the current employer, paginated (per_page max 10, default 5). |
| `employer_search_resumes` | `GET /resumes` | yes | – | Search the hh.ru resume database (employer access, paid service – check with employer_get_manager_method_access). Frequent filters (text, area, salary_from/salary_to, currency, experience, employment_form, label, order_by, page, per_page and others) are top-level parameters. Rare or niche filters are grouped into the nested `advanced` object: pass only the fields you need, unset fields are not sent. The advanced object also carries the dotted spec parameters text.logic, text.field, text.period and text.company_size. Resolve ids first: dict_areas, dict_professional_roles, dict_metro, get_languages. Results are grouped per applicant. |
| `employer_update_applicant_comment` | `PUT /applicant_comments/{applicant_id}/{comment_id}` | yes | yes | Update own comment text or access type (paid access, form-encoded body); omitted fields of body keep their previous values. Returns 204. |
| `employer_update_saved_search` | `PUT /saved_searches/resumes/{id}` | yes | yes | Update a saved resume search: pass either name (rename) or subscription (true/false) in one request – the spec forbids both together. Returns 204 on success. |
